rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector.GetObjectInfo now copes with invalid key setups instead of throwing. When a member's key kind does not match the earlier members, it reports the mixed-key diagnostic and skips that member. When a member reuses an int or string key, the Add into the member dictionary is now guarded, so the earlier member stays registered after the duplicate-key diagnostic is reported. Separately, when no constructor is marked as the serialization constructor, candidate constructors are now tried fewest parameters first instead of most parameters first.
